narrative.intro: Csi Aviation obligated $1.3B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Obligations are up 93.7% year over year. Csi Aviation has an award count of 9 and an average award size of $142M. Year-to-year growth follows a multi-year scaling pattern: FY21 obligations were $2.4M, FY22 obligations were $4.8M, FY23 obligations were $162M, FY24 obligations were $350M, FY25 obligations were $661M, and FY26 obligations are $1.3B. The Department of Homeland Security is the top buyer, having obligated $1.3B to Csi Aviation in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligated $1.7M and the Department of Energy obligated $721K. The largest market for Csi Aviation is All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services at $1.3B, followed by Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation at $2.3M. The page note clarifies that all figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, and that current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). This summary focuses on obligations and the agencies and NAICS markets that bought services in FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Csi Aviation's FY2026 obligations?
sections.body: Csi Aviation's FY2026 obligations are highly concentrated. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $1.3B, which matches the company's total FY2026 obligations of $1.3B. The Department of Defense obligated $1.7M and the Department of Energy obligated $721K, indicating much smaller contributions from other agencies.

sections.heading: How did Csi Aviation's federal obligations change over the last five fiscal years?
sections.body: Csi Aviation's obligations grew each fiscal year from FY21 through FY26. Obligations were $2.4M in FY21, $4.8M in FY22, $162M in FY23, $350M in FY24, $661M in FY25, and $1.3B in FY26. The company reports obligations are up 93.7% year over year.

faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security is the top buyer, having obligated $1.3B. The Department of Defense obligated $1.7M and the Department of Energy obligated $721K in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does Csi Aviation sell to the government?
faq.a: Csi Aviation sells services categorized as All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services, which account for $1.3B, and Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation, which accounts for $2.3M.
